blocks.title: What We Do
blocks.label: Our Mission
blocks.lead: Badger Supports fosters a stronger, more connected UW–Madison by centering peer-to-peer connection.
body: We empower students to support themselves, show up for one another, and build bridges to campus resources and communities of support.

blocks.title: Peer Support Groups
body: Set aside an hour to reset! During Peer Support Groups, there’s no wrong answer, and you can talk about whatever feels most present in your life.

items.text: Academics & Stress: classes, grades, burnout, and balancing work with school.
Uncertainty: identity, uncertainty about the future, and housing.

blocks.title: Craft Nights
body: Need a break from classes? Drop in to a Badger Supports Craft Night! Every other week we host fun, creative events where you can relax, meet new people, and make something cool—like bracelets, vision boards, bedazzled crafts, shrinky dinks, & more!
No experience needed, no sign-ups required—just show up, hang out, and unwind with fellow Badgers.

blocks.title: Wellness Workshops
blocks.lead: We offer peer-led workshops by request for individuals, campus departments, and RSOs. Each session is tailored to your group’s goals, creating space for open conversation, mental health awareness, and community care.

blocks.title: And More!
body: Check out some of our initiatives!
Badger Supports is an independent, dual-registered student organization with University Health Services - Prevention.
